title: 第6章 其实我有男朋友了！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
陶老师打算叫服务员上两瓶啤酒，未曾想一出包间就看见儿子和一个女孩聊天。

    女孩身穿白裙，秀发披肩，一张白净无瑕的清新容颜，美得让人见了就舍不得挪开眼。

    这不就是儿子提及的‘普通同学’吗？

    虽然只见过一次面，但对这个罕见漂亮又气质超群的女孩，陶红记忆无比的深刻，肯定不会认错。

    梁惟石见势不妙，连忙对李清妍敷衍了一句‘我妈找我吃饭了，回头再聊哈’，然后洗手间也不去了，直接上前将双眼放光的陶老师推回了包间。

    李清妍秀眉轻皱，有些怀疑地低头看了看自己。

    她今天有哪里不对吗？

    不然梁惟石怎么会一副唯恐避她不及的表情？

    而这一幕，恰好被刚从洗手间出来的沈晴岚尽收眼底。

    如果说梁惟石出现在这里只是让她觉得有些意外，那么梁惟石与李清妍交谈的情形，则是让她感到十分惊奇。

    沈晴岚缓步走上前，试探着问道：“清妍，你和那个小伙子认识？”

    李清妍坦然回道：“我大学同学，凑巧遇到的。”

    沈晴岚立时反应过来，是了，李清妍也是辽大毕业的。

    李清妍眸光流转，敏锐地注意到了沈睛岚瞥向梁惟石包房的眼神。心中顿时一动，开口问道：“岚姐，你也认识他？”

    按照辈份，其实她应该称呼对方‘岚姨’的，但对方今年才三十六岁，容颜光润，体态修美，实在看不出半点儿姨味儿，所以还是叫姐比较合适。

    沈晴岚微微一笑说道：“说起来还真是巧了，今天下午陪同赵书记到党校视察，一共旁听了两场面试，其中有一场面试的考生，就是你这个同学。”

    顿了一下，又补充了句：“小伙子表现不错，面试很出彩。”

    李清妍不禁若有所思，哦，原来那家伙考公了啊，而且听岚姐的意思，十有八九是考上了。

    ……

    这一边，梁惟石开始谎话连篇，悄声和老妈说什么‘李清妍性格腼腆，不擅言谈，这次不远千里过来，只是为了见我一面。我们刚刚确定关系不久，暂时都没有见家长的打算……’，

    一通连蒙带骗，总算萌混过关。
content_en:
Teacher Tao planned to ask the waiter to bring two bottles of beer, but he never expected to see his son chatting with a girl as soon as he left the private room.

The girl was wearing a white dress, her hair was shawl, and she had a flawless and fresh face. She was so beautiful that people couldn't bear to look away when they saw her.

Isn't this the 'ordinary classmate' my son mentioned?

Although they had only met once, Tao Hong had an extremely deep memory of this rare, beautiful and outstanding girl, and she would definitely not admit her mistake.

Seeing that the situation was not good, Liang Weishi quickly said perfunctorily to Li Qingyan, "My mother is looking for me to eat, let's talk later." Then he didn't go to the bathroom, and went straight forward to push Teacher Tao, whose eyes were shining, back to the private room.

Li Qingyan frowned slightly and looked down at herself with some suspicion.

Is there something wrong with her today?

Otherwise, why would Liang Weishi look like he was afraid of avoiding her?

And this scene happened to be fully visible to Shen Qinglan, who had just come out of the bathroom.

If Liang Weishi's appearance here only surprised her, then the conversation between Liang Weishi and Li Qingyan made her very surprised.

Shen Qinglan walked forward slowly and asked tentatively: "Qingyan, do you know that young man?"

Li Qingyan replied calmly: "I met my college classmate by chance."

Shen Qinglan immediately realized, yes, Li Qingyan also graduated from Liaoning University.

Li Qingyan's eyes moved and she keenly noticed Shen Jinglan's glance towards Liang Weishi's private room.His heart suddenly moved and he asked: "Sister Lan, do you know him too?"

According to her seniority, she should actually call her "Aunt Lan", but she is only thirty-six years old this year, has a smooth face and a beautiful figure. She really doesn't have the slightest hint of aunty, so it is more appropriate to call her sister.

Shen Qinglan smiled slightly and said, "It's a coincidence. I accompanied Secretary Zhao to inspect the Party School this afternoon. I sat in on two interviews in total, and the candidate for one of them was your classmate."

After a pause, he added: "The young man performed well and the interview was outstanding."

Li Qingyan couldn't help but think thoughtfully, oh, so that guy passed the public examination, and according to Sister Lan, there was a high probability that he passed the exam.

…

On this side, Liang Weishi started telling lies, whispering to his mother, "Li Qingyan is shy and not good at talking. She came all the way this time just to see me."We have just established our relationship not long ago, and we have no plans to meet our parents yet...',

After a series of deceptions, he finally passed the test.
title_en: Chapter 6 Actually I have a boyfriend!
